description.name: Entry
description.text:
Tactical Awoken Mode & +500 ATK to user
Tactical Awoken Mode: Holy/Fire Ability Boost, Triplecast Holy/Fire, Unlimited Holy/Fire Hones, Cap Break Level 1 to Holy/Fire Abilities, Holy/Fire Ability Damage +30% & ATB Speed x1.1 to Holy/Fire Abilities; Ends after using 8 Holy/Fire abilities
TP Max: AOE Holy/NE or Fire/NE physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1 under En-Holy or En-Fire

description.name: War-Awoken Loayal Strike (Weapon Skill)
description.text:
Single-target Holy/Fire/NE piercing physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Instant ATB 1 & Instant Cast 1 to user;
During Tactical Awoken Mode, Cap Break Level 2 & ATB Speed x1.2 to Holy/Fire Abilities, and Weapon Skill Blue/Gold at least Lv.0/2 Attach Holy or Attach Fire
WS Blue: Lv.2 En-Holy/Fire Stack to user
WS Gold: Instant Physical to all allies
